```check
set -eu
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/supdl110.XXXXXX)
SERVER_PID=''
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$SERVER_PID" ]; then kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  rm -rf "$TMP"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
fail() { echo "SUP-REQ-DL-110 FAIL: $1" >&2; exit 1; }
if [ -x ../archon-cli/target/release/archon ]; then
  ARCHON() { ../archon-cli/target/release/archon "$@"; }
else
  ARCHON() { cargo run --quiet --release --manifest-path ../archon-cli/Cargo.toml --bin archon -- "$@"; }
fi
pin() {
  name="$1"
  selector="$2"
  kind="$3"
  log="$4"
  if ! cargo test --quiet --release --manifest-path ../archon-cli/Cargo.toml -p archon-trading $kind "$selector" >"$log" 2>&1; then
    fail "pinned REQ-DL-110 capability-probe boundary test $name exited non-zero: $(tail -c 400 "$log")"
  fi
  grep -q 'test result: ok. 1 passed' "$log" || fail "pinned REQ-DL-110 capability-probe boundary test $name did not pass exactly one matched test: $(tail -c 400 "$log")"
}
pin provider_capability_never_calls_full_history data_lake::provider_capability_tests::provider_capability_never_calls_full_history --lib "$TMP/pin-dispatcher.log"
pin capability_probe_is_bounded_and_non_publishing capability_probe_is_bounded_and_non_publishing '--test openbb_polygon_native_ingest' "$TMP/pin-adapter.log"
mkdir -p "$TMP/serve" "$TMP/lake"
cat > "$TMP/serve/server.py" <<'PY'
import http.server, json, socketserver, sys
log_path, port_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
payload = json.dumps({
    'provider': 'polygon', 'symbol': 'BTCUSDT', 'timeframe': '15',
    'adjustment': 'splits', 'corporate_action_source': 'polygon',
    'exchange': 'XNAS', 'timezone': 'America/New_York', 'session': 'regular',
    'calendar': 'XNYS', 'asset_class': 'equity', 'license': 'Polygon terms',
    'requested_start': '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', 'requested_end': '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z',
    'expected_bars': 2, 'native': True, 'derived': False,
    'response_schema': 'openbb-equity-historical', 'response_version': '1',
    'results': [
        {'timestamp': '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', 'open': 1.0, 'high': 2.0, 'low': 0.5, 'close': 1.5, 'volume': 10.0},
        {'timestamp': '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z', 'open': 2.0, 'high': 3.0, 'low': 1.5, 'close': 2.5, 'volume': 20.0}
    ]
}).encode()
class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'
    def do_GET(self):
        with open(log_path, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
            handle.write(self.path + '\n')
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(payload)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(payload)
    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass
server = socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), Handler)
server.daemon_threads = True
with open(port_path, 'w') as handle:
    handle.write(str(server.server_address[1]))
server.serve_forever()
PY
python3 "$TMP/serve/server.py" "$TMP/serve/requests.log" "$TMP/serve/port" &
SERVER_PID=$!
for _ in $(seq 1 100); do
  if [ -s "$TMP/serve/port" ]; then break; fi
  sleep 0.2
done
if [ ! -s "$TMP/serve/port" ]; then fail 'the request-recording capability fixture server never became ready'; fi
PORT=$(cat "$TMP/serve/port")
export OPENBB_API_URL="http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}"
export POLYGON_API_KEY='sup-req-dl-110-fixture-key'
if ! ARCHON trading data capability --target "$TMP/lake" --provider openbb_polygon --symbol BTCUSDT --timeframe 15 >"$TMP/capability.json" 2>"$TMP/capability.log"; then
  fail "the delivered 'trading data capability' command exited non-zero for openbb_polygon/BTCUSDT/15 and produced no section-22 report: $(tail -c 300 "$TMP/capability.log")"
fi
python3 - "$TMP/lake" "$TMP/capability.json" "$TMP/serve/requests.log" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit
lake, report_path, requests_log = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
PROVIDER, SYMBOL, TIMEFRAME = 'openbb_polygon', 'BTCUSDT', '15'
ARTIFACT_REL = '.archon/trading-lab/data/provider-capabilities.json'
SCHEMAS = ('archon-trading-provider-capabilities-v1', 'archon-provider-capabilities-v1')
MAX_PROBE_CANDLES = 2
MAX_PROBE_REQUESTS = 2
def fail(message):
    sys.stderr.write('SUP-REQ-DL-110 FAIL: ' + message + '\n')
    sys.exit(1)
try:
    with open(report_path, encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        text = handle.read().strip()
except OSError as error:
    fail('the capability report is unreadable: %s' % error)
start, end = text.find('{'), text.rfind('}')
if start < 0 or end <= start:
    fail('the delivered capability command printed no JSON report: %r' % text[:200])
try:
    report = json.loads(text[start:end + 1])
except ValueError as error:
    fail('the capability report is not valid JSON: %s' % error)
if not isinstance(report, dict):
    fail('the capability report is not a JSON object')
if report.get('provider') != PROVIDER or report.get('canonical_instrument') != SYMBOL or report.get('symbol') != SYMBOL or report.get('timeframe') != TIMEFRAME:
    fail('the capability report identity (%r/%r/%r) does not echo the requested openbb_polygon/BTCUSDT/15' % (report.get('provider'), report.get('canonical_instrument'), report.get('timeframe')))
can_fetch = report.get('can_fetch')
if not isinstance(can_fetch, bool):
    fail('the capability report carries no boolean can_fetch (%r)' % (can_fetch,))
if not isinstance(report.get('checked_at'), str) or not report['checked_at'].strip():
    fail('the capability report carries no checked_at observation stamp')
reason = report.get('unavailable_reason')
if can_fetch and reason is not None:
    fail('the capability report claims can_fetch=true while also carrying unavailable_reason %r' % (reason,))
if not can_fetch and not (isinstance(reason, str) and reason.strip()):
    fail('the capability report claims can_fetch=false without an exact unavailable_reason')
if not isinstance(report.get('capability_artifact'), str) or not report['capability_artifact'].strip():
    fail('the capability report names no capability_artifact path')
artifact_path = os.path.join(lake, ARTIFACT_REL)
if not os.path.isfile(artifact_path):
    fail('the capability command persisted no provider-capabilities artifact at %s under the --target root, so the verdict is recorded nowhere' % artifact_path)
try:
    with open(artifact_path, encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        artifact = json.load(handle)
except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
    fail('the persisted capability artifact is unreadable or not valid JSON: %s' % error)
if not isinstance(artifact, dict):
    fail('the persisted capability artifact is not a JSON object')
schema = artifact.get('schema_version', artifact.get('schema'))
if schema not in SCHEMAS:
    fail('the persisted capability artifact schema is %r, expected the frozen provider-capabilities schema id' % (schema,))
cells = artifact.get('capabilities')
if isinstance(cells, dict):
    cells = list(cells.values())
if not isinstance(cells, list):
    fail('the persisted capability artifact carries no capabilities collection')
matching = [cell for cell in cells if isinstance(cell, dict) and str(cell.get('provider') or '').lower() == PROVIDER and (cell.get('canonical_instrument') or cell.get('symbol')) == SYMBOL and cell.get('timeframe') == TIMEFRAME]
if not matching:
    fail('the persisted capability artifact records no cell for openbb_polygon/BTCUSDT/15')
if matching[0].get('can_fetch') != can_fetch:
    fail('the persisted cell can_fetch %r disagrees with the printed report can_fetch %r' % (matching[0].get('can_fetch'), can_fetch))
requests = []
if os.path.isfile(requests_log):
    with open(requests_log, encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        requests = [line.strip() for line in handle.read().splitlines() if line.strip()]
if len(requests) > MAX_PROBE_REQUESTS:
    fail('REQ-DL-110 violated: one capability check drove %d provider request(s) (%s); a capability check must never degrade into a download campaign' % (len(requests), ' | '.join(requests[:3])))
for request_line in requests:
    limits = parse_qs(urlsplit(request_line).query).get('limit', [])
    if not limits or not limits[0].isdigit() or int(limits[0]) > MAX_PROBE_CANDLES:
        fail('REQ-DL-110 violated: the capability check performed an unbounded provider download - request %r carries no bar limit <= %d, i.e. a full-history fetch instead of a bounded probe' % (request_line, MAX_PROBE_CANDLES))
note = 'no provider request at all, so the capability verdict resolved from static support tables and credential detection and downloaded nothing' if not requests else '%d bounded probe request(s), each carrying the %d-candle bar cap' % (len(requests), MAX_PROBE_CANDLES)
sys.stderr.write('SUP-REQ-DL-110 exercise ok: the delivered capability command reported openbb_polygon/BTCUSDT/15 (can_fetch=%r), persisted the frozen-schema artifact cell, and the request-recording fixture observed %s\n' % (can_fetch, note))
PY
echo 'SUP-REQ-DL-110 PASS: capability checks never perform expensive full downloads - the pinned dispatcher test provider_capability_never_calls_full_history (crates/archon-trading/src/data_lake/provider_capability_tests.rs) proves the capability path performs zero full-history fetches, the pinned integration test capability_probe_is_bounded_and_non_publishing (crates/archon-trading/tests/openbb_polygon_native_ingest.rs) proves the provider capability probe is exactly one request carrying the limit=2 bar cap with candles_examined=2 and publishes nothing, and the delivered trading data capability command for openbb_polygon/BTCUSDT/15 returned a section-22 report persisted to .archon/trading-lab/data/provider-capabilities.json under the --target root while the request-recording fixture server observed either no provider request at all or only bar-capped probe requests (limit<=2), so a capability check can never silently turn into an expensive full download'
```
